repo_notes.content: Neurouter Hub is a self-hosted enterprise MCP gateway. apps/server = Fastify API + /mcp gateway; apps/web = React admin console and user portal; packages/shared = zod API contract. Key concepts: agents (identities owned by users), grants (deny wins), tool pinning, approvals (held calls), hash-chained audit log with signed checkpoints, OAuth 2.1 authorization server, hybrid tool search with a local embedding model. Supports MCP 2026-07-28 and 2025-11-25. SQLite for local dev, Postgres + pgvector in production.
